sections.title: How to use this pack
sections.lead: One pack, five readers. Each reader needs two or three sections; the rest is context. Everything here follows the shoot plan both sides agreed: 7 September full day and 8 September morning at the 1688 Hangzhou campus, English on camera, Ary on camera for one afternoon.

blocks.text: Rules of the day

items: English on camera. Chinese prompting off camera is fine; the take then restarts in English from the top.
One question, one take. Every answer stands alone. No "as I said earlier", no reference to another answer, no client, customer or buyer named. If it happens, the take goes again.
Framed safe for 9:16: subject centred, nothing essential at the sides of the frame.
Every Q&A answer ends on the same line: "And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct." It is the last line of every answer sheet.
On-claim wording only. The payment route is "the official cross-border payment solution from 1688 and WorldFirst". Never "the only".
Numbers Ary says on camera come from 1688. Where a sheet shows a bracket, 1688 fills it before the day; if a bracket stays empty, the line is cut, not guessed.
The brand is written WorldFirst. Never WORLDFIRST, never World First.

sections.title: Run of show · 7 and 8 September
sections.lead: The times both sides agreed, with what each block produces and where its content sits in this pack. Ary is needed from 14:00 to 16:30 on 7 September only.

Thank you, release form signed, one photo for the record.
Aria's WorldFirst-side mutual credit take while the set is lit, her homecoming piece at the entrance if light allows, any re-asks, 30 seconds of room tone. Sections 05 and 06.
Card count, dual backup, release forms, exceptions log, shot log against the IDs in this pack. Section 08.
Undisturbed exteriors, signage, office environment, remaining detail B-roll. Shot list B in section 08.

sections.title: Ary's testimonial scripts
sections.lead: 30 to 60 seconds, direct to lens, composed and steady. Two versions, each with a 30-second alternate. The words can move to suit Ary; the claims cannot. No client is named. Version A carries the sentence the whole campaign needs from 1688: that Southeast Asian businesses are exactly who this is for.

blocks.title: Version A · Built for you
lines: Hello. I'm Ary, and I look after 1688's Southeast Asia market.
1688 is the wholesale marketplace where businesses in China buy from factories, every day.
For a long time, buyers outside China could see our prices. But they couldn't buy easily.
That has changed.
Today a business in Malaysia, Vietnam or Thailand can buy on 1688 directly. [1688 confirms the markets named]
No agent in the middle. No borrowed account.
You register as your own business. You talk to the supplier. You place the order.
And when it's time to pay, you pay direct, through our official cross-border payment with WorldFirst.
Southeast Asian businesses are exactly who we built this for.
This is the marketplace our own businesses use. Now it's open to yours.
notes: Read twice. Second read slower, with a pause after "That has changed."
If Ary prefers not to name markets, the line becomes: "Today a business in Southeast Asia can buy on 1688 directly."

blocks.title: Version B · The payment part
lines: I'm Ary from 1688. I'm responsible for our Southeast Asia market.
The question I hear most from overseas buyers isn't about price. It's about payment.
"How do I pay a Chinese supplier from my own bank account?"
Here's the answer.
1688 works with WorldFirst on an official cross-border payment solution for buyers outside China.
You pay in Chinese yuan from your WorldFirst account, at checkout, like any other order on 1688.
The supplier is paid through the platform. Your order is protected by the platform.
No sourcing agent. No stranger's account. No card that stops working.
Buy direct on 1688. Pay direct with WorldFirst.
That's the route we built together.
notes: The quoted question is read as a question, with a small pause before "Here's the answer."

blocks.title: Alternate A · 30 seconds
lines: I'm Ary. I look after 1688's Southeast Asia market.
1688 is where businesses in China buy wholesale, from the factories themselves.
Today a business in Southeast Asia can buy here directly. No agent, no borrowed account.
You register as your own business, you talk to the supplier, and you pay direct, through our official cross-border payment with WorldFirst.
You are exactly who we built this for.

blocks.title: Alternate B · 30 seconds
lines: I'm Ary from 1688.
The biggest question from overseas buyers is payment. How do I pay a supplier from my own account?
1688 and WorldFirst built the official answer.
You pay in Chinese yuan from your WorldFirst account, at checkout, and the supplier is paid through the platform.
Buy direct on 1688. Pay direct with WorldFirst.

blocks.text: Delivery: professional register. Steady eye contact with the lens, hands still or resting, conviction on every number, one deliberate pause per version. Not chatty, not amused. If a read comes out flat, the fix is weight and a slower pace, not a lighter tone.

sections.title: Ary's answer sheets
sections.lead: One sheet per take, in the order of section 03. Each sheet has the line that opens the reel on screen (the buyer's own words, no username), the question as Aria asks it, the answer as Ary reads it, a Chinese cue for the meaning, and the brackets 1688 fills before the day. Every answer is 40 to 60 seconds read slowly, and every answer ends on the payment line.

blocks.text: Reading notes for Ary: short sentences, one idea per line, contractions are fine. Read at the pace of explaining something to one person across a table. If a bracket has not been filled, skip the line; never guess a number on camera.

blocks.title: Can a business outside China buy on 1688 without an agent?
blocks.asks: Can a business outside China buy on 1688 without an agent? Yes or no.
lines: Yes. A business outside China can buy on 1688 without an agent.
You register as your own company. You talk to the supplier yourself. You place the order yourself.
An agent can still be useful if you want someone to check the goods or handle shipping for you.
But you don't need one to buy.
The platform is open to overseas business buyers. [1688 confirms: in the markets named in B6]
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 海外企业可以直接在1688注册、下单，不需要代购或中介。代理只是可选的服务，不是必须的。
fills: Any market or registration limit that changes "yes" to "yes, in these markets".
blocks.coldopen: Can foreign buyers use 1688 directly, or do I need an agent?
blocks.source: the question every English guide to 1688 opens with

blocks.title: Do I need a Chinese ID or a China phone number to register?
blocks.asks: Do I need a Chinese ID card, or a China phone number, to register on 1688?
lines: No. You don't need a Chinese ID card, and you don't need a China phone number.
Overseas buyers register with their own details. [1688 confirms: email or international mobile number, and which documents]
To buy as a business and pay from overseas, you verify your business once. [1688 confirms the current path, in three steps]
It takes a few steps, and you only do it once.
After that, you log in like any other buyer.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 不需要中国身份证或中国手机号。海外买家用自己的信息注册，企业认证只需完成一次。
fills: The exact current registration and verification path for a business outside China, written as three short steps Ary can read.
blocks.coldopen: Why does 1688 have such a complex registration process when you register from outside China?

blocks.title: Why does 1688 reject my foreign card at checkout?
blocks.asks: Why does 1688 reject my foreign card at checkout? It works on small orders, then it stops.
lines: Foreign cards work on some orders, and then they stop. That confuses a lot of buyers.
Here's why. Card payment on 1688 is for small orders, and it's not available for every seller or every order type. [1688 confirms the card rules]
For a business buying regularly, the route we built is different.
You pay in Chinese yuan from a WorldFirst account, at checkout, through 1688's official cross-border payment.
It works on the orders where cards don't, and the order is protected by the platform like any other. [1688 and WorldFirst confirm the coverage wording]
So when your card stops, that's not a dead end. That's where the direct route starts.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 外卡只能付小额、部分订单。企业常规采购走官方跨境支付：用WorldFirst账户的人民币在结账时直接付款，平台担保。
fills: The card rules in one sentence: which orders accept cards, and the limit, if any.
blocks.coldopen: I have the option to use a credit card for some orders, but now it's only letting me use WorldFirst. What do I do?

blocks.title: How does my money get from my bank in Kuala Lumpur to a factory in Guangdong?
blocks.asks: Walk me through it. How does my money actually get from my bank in Kuala Lumpur to a factory in Guangdong?
lines: Let me walk you through it. Five steps.
One. You open a WorldFirst account for your business, and you link it to your 1688 account. You do this once.
Two. You put money into that account from your own bank, in your own currency, and convert it to Chinese yuan.
Three. On 1688, you place the order, the same way a buyer in China does.
Four. At checkout, you choose the WorldFirst option. The yuan comes out of your account.
Five. The platform holds the payment, and releases it to the supplier once the order is on its way. [1688 confirms the release rule for cross-border orders]
The factory sees a normal 1688 order. You see one payment, in yuan, from your own account.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 五步：开通并绑定WorldFirst账户；用本币充值并换成人民币；像国内买家一样下单；结账选WorldFirst；平台担保，发货后放款给供应商。
fills: Confirm step five: when the platform releases payment to the supplier on a cross-border order.
blocks.coldopen: Even if you get through the interface, checkout is a dead end.

blocks.title: Which countries can pay direct today?
blocks.asks: Which countries can pay direct today? Name them.
lines: Here's the list, so nobody has to guess.
Today, businesses in [1688 confirms the list, for example: Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand] can register on 1688 and pay direct.
If your country is on that list, you can buy today.
If it isn't, keep an eye on us. We're adding markets. [1688 confirms this can be said]
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 这条只念1688确认的国家名单。如果不能在镜头前给名单，这条不拍，名单放落地页。
fills: The authoritative list of markets where a business can register and pay direct today, on the record.
Whether "we're adding markets" can be said on camera.
blocks.coldopen: I have a WorldFirst account, but it says I'm regionally restricted to make the payment.

blocks.title: What does buying direct cost me, all in?
blocks.asks: What does buying direct cost me, all in? Honestly.
lines: Let's do the honest maths.
Through a sourcing agent, you usually pay five to fifteen per cent of the order. And the agent sets your exchange rate. Those numbers come from the agents' own price lists.

Direct on 1688, you pay the supplier's price, plus the platform's cross-border payment fee, plus WorldFirst's payment fee. Together that's about one per cent. [1688 confirms the 0.2 per cent platform fee; WorldFirst confirms 0.8 per cent]
You still pay shipping and duty either way.
So the difference is the agent's cut. On a large order, that's real money, and it stays in your business.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 代理通常收5%到15%并自定汇率；直采只付供应商价格加约1%的支付费用（平台0.2%加WorldFirst 0.8%），运费和关税两边都一样。
fills: Confirm the 0.2 per cent platform fee wording.
If 1688 prefers not to quote agent fees on camera, the second line becomes: "Through a middleman, you pay their fee and their exchange rate on top."
blocks.coldopen: I'm unsure how to pay without getting charged a 1.5% and 3% payment service fee.

blocks.title: People tell me to top up a stranger's Alipay, or pay through someone's QQ. Is that really the system?
blocks.asks: People tell me to top up a stranger's Alipay, or to pay through someone's QQ account. Is that really the system?
lines: No. That is not the system.
Those are workarounds. Someone in China pays for you from their account, and you send them money some other way.
It sometimes works. But your money sits with a person, not with the platform. If something goes wrong with the order, you have no protection, because the order isn't yours.
The official route is simpler. Your business, your account, your order, and a payment the platform can see.
There's no need to borrow anyone's account.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 找人代付不是官方途径，钱在个人手里、订单不在你名下、没有平台保护。官方途径：自己的企业、自己的账户、自己的订单。
blocks.coldopen: Pay-on-behalf: enter the ID and QQ account of the authorised intermediary.

blocks.title: Will it ship to my country, and who handles that part?
blocks.asks: Will it even ship to my country? And who handles that part?
lines: Two parts to this.
Inside China, the supplier ships to any address in China. That part is included in most listings. [1688 confirms]
From China to your country, you use a freight forwarder. That's a company with a warehouse in China. Your goods go to their warehouse, they combine your orders, and they ship to you by sea or by air.
Most overseas buyers on 1688 work this way, and most forwarders know 1688 well.
[Optional, 1688 confirms: one line on 1688's own cross-border logistics in pilot markets.]
So yes, it ships. The forwarder handles the border.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 供应商负责国内段，海外买家用货代（在中国有仓库，集货后海运或空运）。如1688有自营跨境物流试点，可加一句。
fills: Whether domestic shipping is included on most listings.
Whether to mention 1688's own cross-border logistics, and in which markets.
blocks.coldopen: Does anyone know how to add a shipping address? Singapore isn't an available option.

blocks.title: When is buying direct not cheaper?
blocks.asks: When is buying direct not cheaper? Be honest.
lines: I'll be straight with you. Direct is not always cheaper.
Three cases.
Small orders. If you're buying a few hundred yuan of goods, shipping and handling can cost more than the goods.
Bulky, cheap goods. If the item is big and low in value, freight eats the saving.
And duty. You are the importer, so duty and tax in your country are yours to pay. Check the rate for your product before you order, not after.
Direct wins when you order in volume, regularly, and you know your landed cost.
That's how businesses in China use this platform, and that's how it works for you too.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 直采不总是更便宜：小额订单、大件低值货、以及进口关税。批量、常规、算清到岸成本，直采才划算。
blocks.coldopen: Scared of getting hit by customs duty.
blocks.source: top comment on the biggest Indonesian sourcing video, translated

blocks.title: What is 1688, in one sentence?
blocks.asks: For someone who has never heard of it: what is 1688, in one sentence?
lines: 1688 is the wholesale marketplace where businesses in China buy from Chinese factories.
That's the one sentence.
It started in 1999, it's part of Alibaba, and today more than one hundred million businesses buy on it every year. [1688 confirms the current number]
Shops, restaurants, online sellers, other factories. They all source here.
If you've ever bought a product made in China, there's a good chance the person who sold it to you bought it here first.
And now, businesses outside China can buy here too.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 一句话：1688是中国企业向中国工厂批发采购的平台。1999年起步，阿里旗下，年活跃买家超一亿。现在海外企业也能买。
fills: The current annual active buyer number, and the year Ary should cite.
blocks.coldopen: Buying from 1688 is a headache where I live. But I still check it, just to see the prices.

blocks.title: 1688, Taobao, Alibaba.com: what's the difference?
blocks.asks: 1688, Taobao, Alibaba.com. Same company. So what's the difference?
lines: Same family, three different jobs.
Taobao is for consumers. One person, one item.
Alibaba.com is for international trade. The suppliers there are set up for export: English, US dollars, international shipping built in.
1688 is for businesses inside China. Chinese language, Chinese yuan, wholesale quantities, and the price a Chinese shop owner pays.
That's why the same product can look cheaper on 1688. You're seeing the domestic wholesale price, without the export services on top.
The trade-off is that you do more yourself: the language, the shipping, and until recently, the payment.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 淘宝面向消费者；Alibaba.com面向国际贸易（英文、美元、含出口服务）；1688面向中国企业（中文、人民币、批发价）。所以同款在1688看起来更便宜，但语言、物流要自己处理。
blocks.coldopen: Is 1688 really cheaper than Alibaba?
blocks.source: the question with 3.68 million views behind it

blocks.title: Why are the prices lower?
blocks.asks: Why are the prices lower than anywhere else I've seen?
lines: Because this is where China itself buys.
The suppliers on 1688 sell to Chinese businesses, in Chinese, in yuan, at wholesale quantity. There's no export margin, no translation, no international service built into the price.
Many of them are the factories behind the brands you already stock.
So you're not getting a special price. You're getting the same price a shop owner in Guangzhou gets.
What you add yourself is shipping to your country, and duty.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 价格低是因为这是中国企业自己采购的地方：国内批发价，没有出口溢价和国际服务。你看到的就是广州店主拿到的价格，自己加上运费和关税。
blocks.coldopen: Why is 1688 so much cheaper?
blocks.source: asked under every price-comparison video in the category

blocks.title: Who is buying here every day?
blocks.asks: Who is actually buying here, every day?
lines: Mostly businesses in China. More than one hundred million of them a year. [1688 confirms]
Small shops restocking. Restaurants buying equipment. Online sellers finding their next product. Factories buying parts from other factories.
It's not a place people browse for fun. It's where businesses do their weekly buying.
And a growing number of those buyers are now outside China, in Southeast Asia. [1688 confirms whether a number can be said]
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 主要是中国企业：小店补货、餐厅买设备、电商选品、工厂买零件。海外（尤其东南亚）买家在增长。
fills: Whether an overseas or Southeast Asia buyer number can be said.

blocks.title: When an overseas buyer pays on 1688, who carries the money?
blocks.asks: When an overseas buyer pays on 1688, who carries the money?
lines: WorldFirst carries the money.
WorldFirst is our official cross-border payment partner for buyers outside China.
The buyer pays from a WorldFirst account, in Chinese yuan, and 1688 receives it like any payment from a buyer in China.
That's the role they play. Simple as that.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 互相背书，1688这一侧：WorldFirst是1688面向海外买家的官方跨境支付合作伙伴。用自己的话说，不用照读。
fills: Ary may say this in his own words. The two fixed points: "official cross-border payment partner", and never "the only".
blocks.coldopen: Who is WorldFirst to 1688?
blocks.source: the credit exchange, cut against the WorldFirst side in section 06

blocks.text: Stretch sheets · section 03 S1 to S7

blocks.title: Is there an English version, or am I stuck translating?
blocks.asks: Is there an English version of 1688, or am I stuck translating?
lines: The platform is built in Chinese. [1688 confirms what English support exists today, if any]
Most overseas buyers use the translation built into their browser or phone, and it works well enough for searching and for chatting with suppliers.
Product photos, prices and quantities need no translation.
[1688 fills: if language support is on the roadmap, one line here.]
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 平台以中文为主，海外买家多用浏览器或手机自带翻译。如有英文支持或规划，由1688给一句。
fills: What English-language support exists today, and whether more is planned.
blocks.coldopen: I can't even create an account. I can't read the language to fill in the info.

blocks.title: Why doesn't the direct payment option appear on every listing?
blocks.asks: Sometimes the direct payment option isn't there at checkout. Why doesn't it appear on every listing?
lines: Good question, and here's the honest answer.
The direct payment option appears on [1688 fills: the plain rule, for example platform-secured orders from suppliers open to overseas buyers].
It doesn't appear on [1688 fills: the exceptions, for example orders not under platform protection, credit-term orders, restricted items].
If you don't see it, [1688 fills: what the buyer should do, for example ask the supplier to place the order as a secured transaction].
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 直接支付选项的覆盖规则和例外，由1688用最简单的话给出。
fills: The coverage rule and the exceptions, in plain language.
blocks.coldopen: My order only shows some payment options. Why isn't it on every listing?

blocks.title: How do I know the landed price before I commit?
blocks.asks: How do I know the landed price before I commit to an order?
lines: Five numbers, and you have it.
The goods: the 1688 price, times the quantity.
Domestic freight: from the factory to your forwarder's warehouse. Often included.
International freight: your forwarder quotes it per kilo or per cubic metre. Ask before you order.
Duty and tax in your country, for your product. Your customs office or your forwarder can tell you the rate.
And the forwarder's own fee.
Add them up. That's your landed price. If it still beats what you pay today, order.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 到岸价五项：货值、国内运费、国际运费、本国关税税费、货代费用。下单前先算。
blocks.coldopen: The price is low, but the shipping fee is huge.

blocks.title: What happens if the goods arrive wrong?
blocks.asks: What happens if the goods arrive wrong?
lines: Orders paid through the platform are protected by the platform. [1688 confirms]
If the goods are wrong, you open a dispute in the order, with photos. [1688 fills: the steps and the time window]
[1688 fills: what the platform does, for example mediation, refund, return.]
That's why paying through the platform matters. A payment the platform can see is a payment the platform can protect.
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 平台内支付的订单有平台保护；收货有误在订单内发起纠纷。流程和时限由1688给出。
fills: The dispute route for cross-border orders, including any change to the refund policy in the last year.
blocks.coldopen: What if I pay and they send the wrong thing?

blocks.title: Why is it called 1688?
blocks.asks: Why is it called 1688?
lines: In Chinese, one, six, eight, eight sounds like "yi lu fa fa".
It means: prosperity all the way.
It's a lucky number, and it's easy to remember. [Ary adds the story if there is one]
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 1688谐音“一路发发”。有故事可以加。
blocks.coldopen: What does 1688 mean?

blocks.title: Singapore · the four beats, plus why a high-cost city buys so much wholesale
blocks.asks: Singapore. What do Singapore businesses buy most, what's growing, and why does a high-cost city buy so much wholesale?
lines: Singapore. Here's what we see.
What they buy: [1688 fills].
What's growing: [1688 fills].
One surprise: [1688 fills].
One piece of advice: [1688 fills].
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: 新加坡四拍，由1688提供。
fills: The four beats for Singapore.
blocks.coldopen: Has anyone in Singapore bought from 1688 successfully?

blocks.title: Your one tip for every new overseas buyer
blocks.asks: Your personal top tip. The one thing you'd tell every new overseas buyer.
lines: One thing.
[Ary's own tip, in his own words. Fallback: start with a sample order from a supplier with a factory badge and years on the platform, then scale.]
And when it's time to pay, you can pay direct.
blocks.zh: Ary自己的一条建议。备选：先从有实力工厂标识、平台年限长的供应商下样品单，再放量。
blocks.coldopen: Any tips for a first-time 1688 buyer?

sections.title: The campus walk
sections.lead: The walk is picture first, words second. Ary's spoken load is light: one or two short lines per leg, in his own words or from the card. Aria carries the links. Everything that has to be said has already been said in the seat, so a line that does not land on the walk costs nothing.

blocks.text: Leg 1 · Arrival and entrance · 15 minutes

rows.label: Picture
rows.value: Aria walks up to the entrance; Ary meets her at the door; the 1688 sign; the two of them walking in together. Wide, then following.

rows.label: Aria's link
rows.value: "I used to walk through this door every morning. Today I'm back, on the other side of the table."

rows.label: Aria asks
rows.value: "For someone in Malaysia who has never been here: what is this place?"

rows.label: Ary's line
rows.value: "This is 1688's home in Hangzhou. Everything the platform does starts here."

rows.label: Second camera
rows.value: Signage, badges, lobby screens, feet walking, reflections in the glass. No faces in focus unless released.

blocks.text: Leg 2 · Showroom and samples · 20 minutes

rows.label: Picture
rows.value: Sample racks and product walls; hands picking up products; Ary showing one item and what a listing looks like for it.

rows.label: Aria asks
rows.value: "Who buys these?"

rows.label: Ary's line
rows.value: "Shops, restaurants, online sellers, other factories. This is where China buys wholesale."

rows.label: Aria asks
rows.value: "Why does the price read lower here?"

rows.label: Ary's line
rows.value: "Because this is the domestic wholesale price. The same price a shop in Guangzhou pays."

rows.label: Aria asks
rows.value: "What's the strangest thing you've seen someone source here?" Ary's own story, in his own words. If he has none, skip.

rows.label: Second camera
rows.value: Product details, labels, QR codes, tags. No confidential pricing, no client names.

rows.label: Fallback
rows.value: If the sample selection centre is closed: the showroom, meeting areas and any product display cleared for filming. The same three questions.

blocks.text: Leg 3 · Offices and operations, ending at goods-out · 25 minutes

rows.label: Picture
rows.value: Open office, the team at work, screens without personal data; a desk where Ary opens the app; then the goods-out area, boxes, barcodes, a truck if permitted.

rows.label: At the desk
rows.value: The app demo, ten minutes, four short screens. See the demo sheets below. Over the shoulder on the phone; Ary's lines can be recorded again in the interview corner if the room is noisy.

rows.label: Aria asks · at goods-out
rows.value: "What happens between me clicking order and a box leaving here?"

rows.label: Ary's line
rows.value: "The supplier confirms the order. The goods are packed at the factory. The platform holds your payment. The goods ship to your forwarder, and once they're on their way, the supplier is paid." [1688 confirms the sequence]

rows.label: Aria closes the walk
rows.value: "So the goods go out that way. And the money comes back the other way."

rows.label: Second camera
rows.value: Screens, hands, boxes, barcodes, trolleys, wayfinding signs, orange brand accents.

blocks.text: The app demo · four screens at the desk

rows.label: E1 · Image search
rows.value: Screen: camera icon, photo of any product on the desk, results. Ary: "Take a photo of any product. 1688 finds the factories that make it. Same item, dozens of suppliers, wholesale prices."

rows.label: E2 · Three signals of a real factory
rows.value: Screen: one listing, pointing at each badge. Ary: "Three things I look at. The factory badge. The years on the platform. The repeat-buyer rate. If all three are strong, you're probably talking to the factory, not a trader." [1688 confirms which signals it endorses]

rows.label: E3 · Price tiers
rows.value: Screen: the price ladder on a listing. Ary: "Prices step down with quantity. The real price is the one at the quantity you'll actually order. If you're between tiers, ask the supplier."

rows.label: E4 · Sample first
rows.value: Screen: ordering one unit. Ary: "Order one unit first. Many suppliers allow a sample order. Check it, then place the volume order." [1688 confirms]

rows.label: Capture
rows.value: On the day: over-the-shoulder on Ary's own phone, logged into his account, no personal data on screen. After the day: clean screen recordings of the same four screens from 1688, in 9:16 and 16:9, on the handover list in section 09. The episodes are cut from the clean recordings with Ary's voice.

blocks.text: Aria's homecoming piece · at wrap, internal

blocks.title: Homecoming · Version 1
blocks.meta: about 45 seconds · to lens · entrance if light allows, else the interview corner
lines: I spent [Aria fills: years] inside this building. I worked on [Aria fills: what she did, one phrase].
Then I joined WorldFirst. And I've spent the time since on the same problem, from the other side.
The moment an overseas buyer finds the right supplier here, tries to pay, and can't.
Today we came back with a camera, to show you what's behind the marketplace your supplier uses.
And to say the payment part is handled.

blocks.title: Homecoming · Version 2 · 30 seconds
lines: I used to work here. Now I work on the other side of the same problem.
Businesses in Southeast Asia know 1688. They just couldn't pay.
That's what WorldFirst does. Today, 1688 let us bring a camera inside to show you the rest.

sections.title: Mutual credit wording
sections.lead: Two takes, shot separately, cut as one exchange. 1688 describes WorldFirst's role in its own words; WorldFirst hands 1688 its credit back. The claims match the product page wording, "the official cross-border payment solution provided by 1688.com and WorldFirst", and never say "the only".

blocks.title: 1688 side · Ary · Variant A
blocks.meta: about 20 seconds · seated, take 19 of the Q&A hour
lines: When an overseas buyer pays on 1688, WorldFirst carries the money.
WorldFirst is our official cross-border payment partner for buyers outside China.
The buyer pays from a WorldFirst account, in Chinese yuan, and 1688 receives it like any payment from a buyer in China.
That's the role they play. Simple as that.

blocks.title: 1688 side · Ary · Variant B
lines: Who carries the money? WorldFirst.
They're the official cross-border payment partner for 1688's overseas buyers.
You pay them in your currency, and the supplier gets paid in yuan through the platform.
Payment was the hard part. Now it isn't.

blocks.title: WorldFirst side · Aria on campus · Variant A
blocks.meta: about 25 seconds · interview corner at wrap · same framing as Ary's take
lines: And 1688? 1688 is the source.
It's where our customers' suppliers sell, at the price businesses in China pay.
Our job is the payment. A business in Kuala Lumpur pays that factory in yuan, from its own WorldFirst account, and 1688 treats it like any order from a buyer in China.
1688 opened the platform to overseas buyers. We make the payment work.

blocks.title: WorldFirst side · Aria on campus · Variant B
lines: 1688 is where China buys wholesale. That's the source.
We're the payment. You pay from your own account, the factory is paid through the platform.
They opened the door. We built the checkout.

blocks.text: If Daniel records the WorldFirst side in Singapore later, he reads F2-a or F2-b as written, first person plural, framed to mirror Ary's seat. On-screen credit wording for the edit, subject to 1688 brand approval: "1688 · official cross-border payment partner: WorldFirst".

sections.title: Aria's host sheet
sections.lead: How to run the seat and the walk so that every take is usable on its own. Aria reads this once before the day and keeps it beside the lens.

blocks.text: Before cameras roll · lunch

items: Walk Ary through the afternoon in this order: testimonial, Q&A, walk. Show him the prompter and let him read Version A once, off camera, at his own pace.
Agree the restart cue in Chinese: "我们再来一次，从头。" He restarts from the first line, in English, without explaining.
Tell him the two things that force a retake: naming a client or company, and referring to another answer. Everything else is fixable in the edit.
Agree which brackets in section 04 are filled and which lines are cut. Cross the cut lines out on his printed set.

blocks.text: In the seat

items: Ask each question once, in the words on the sheet, then silence. No "mm-hm", no verbal nods; they land on his audio track.
Count two seconds after his last word before you speak, so every take has a clean tail.
If he stumbles, let him finish, then take it again from the top. A take that starts mid-answer cannot be used alone.
Chinese prompting between takes is fine. The take itself restarts in English from line one.
If he forgets the payment line, ask for it alone as a pickup: "Just the last line, please."
The crew voice-slates every take with the pack ID and take number ("B5, take 2"). You confirm the ID before each question.
Sit off-axis so Ary looks at you, not the lens. The testimonial is the exception: to lens, and you sit directly beneath it.
The clock: start 14:30; checkpoint 15:10; if fewer than twelve takes are done, jump to E6, E7 and F1. Ary is released at 16:30 whatever is left.

blocks.text: On the walk

items: You carry the links; Ary carries one or two lines per leg. If he is tired or hot, drop questions and keep pictures. The seat already has the words.
Reset points are at the start of each leg. Sound checks there, not mid-leg.
Stop if 1688's minder objects to a location or a screen. Nothing on the walk is worth a permission argument.

blocks.text: Never on camera

items: Client, customer or buyer names. Confidential 1688 numbers unless Ary offers them. Personal data on screens. "The only" in any wording about payment.

sections.title: Crew sheet · Sean and Alan
sections.lead: Builds on the vendor's execution plan (V2): two cameras, lavaliers plus boom, 4K, dual backup, footage handover only. Three additions from our side: a prompter under the lens, the pack IDs on every slate and clip name, and the two shot lists below. English first, Chinese underneath each row.

blocks.text: Interview corner · 访谈机位

rows.label: Cameras
rows.value: A: front, slightly off-axis, medium shot. B: same side, 30 to 45 degrees, medium close-up. Both centred for 9:16: subject in the middle third, headroom kept, nothing essential at the edges. 主机正面偏侧中景；B机同侧30到45度中近景；两机都按9:16安全构图，人物居中，两侧不放关键信息。

rows.label: Background
rows.value: A calm, 1688-identifiable room: media room, meeting room or office. Brand marks in the environment, not stuck on. 安静、有1688辨识度的房间；品牌标识自然入镜，不硬摆。

rows.label: Prompter
rows.value: A tablet teleprompter directly under the A-camera lens, loaded with sections 02, 04 and 06 of this pack in large type. Ary reads from it. This is the one addition to the vendor's kit list, and the biggest quality lever of the day. 主机镜头正下方放平板提词器，加载本包第02、04、06节，大字号。这是本次唯一新增设备，也是最重要的。

rows.label: Sound
rows.value: One lavalier per speaker plus a boom, separate tracks, 48 kHz 24-bit, 30 seconds of room tone before the first take. Air conditioning off during takes; water and tissues for Ary between takes. 每人独立领夹麦加枪麦，分轨录制，开拍前录30秒环境底噪；录制时关空调；准备水和纸巾。

rows.label: Slate and log
rows.value: Voice-slate every take with the pack ID and take number ("B5, take 2"). The log carries ID, take, good or NG, and the reason. 每条口头报板：本包编号加条次；日志记编号、条次、可用与否、原因。

rows.label: Testimonial reframe
rows.value: Same corner, tighter, to lens, cleaner background. Two reads per version. 同一机位略收紧，直视镜头，背景更干净，每版录两遍。

blocks.text: Walk coverage · 走访拍摄

rows.label: A camera
rows.value: Gimbal on the pair, wide and medium, following and leading. Reset at the start of each leg. 稳定器跟拍两人，全景与中景，每段起点重置。

rows.label: B camera
rows.value: Handheld or long lens on inserts: hands, products, screens, signage, feet, reflections. 手持或长焦补细节：手部、产品、屏幕、标识、脚步、反光。

rows.label: Sound
rows.value: Wireless lavaliers on both, boom where possible. The words are secondary to the pictures on the walk. 两人无线领夹，条件允许加枪麦；走访以画面为主。

rows.label: App demo
rows.value: Over the shoulder on Ary's phone at a desk, screen filling the frame, ten minutes, four screens as in section 05. 办公桌前过肩拍Ary手机屏幕，四个界面，见第05节。

blocks.text: Shot list A · D1 morning · 第一天上午

cells: Entrance, building with 1688 signage: wide, medium, detail. Morning light. 园区入口、带1688标识的楼体：全景、中景、特写。
Reception, screens, visitor flow, wayfinding. No faces in focus unless released. 大堂前台、屏幕、人流、导视；未授权的人脸不合焦。
Recce all three legs; mark reset points; check light and noise; agree the goods-out access. 三段走访路线踩点，定重置点，查光线噪声，确认出货区可进。
Racks, product walls, hands with products, tags and QR codes. Only if open; otherwise cleared displays. 样品架、产品墙、手持产品、标签二维码；仅限可拍区域。
Open plan, meeting rooms, team at work. No confidential content on whiteboards or screens. 开放办公区、会议室、工作状态；白板屏幕无敏感内容。

1688 app and site on a clean phone or laptop: search, a listing, price tiers, checkout showing the WorldFirst option if a linked test account is available. 干净设备上的1688应用与网站：搜索、商品页、阶梯价、结账页显示WorldFirst选项（如有测试账户）。
Goods-out area, boxes, barcodes, trolleys, a truck if permitted. 出货区、纸箱、条码、推车、卡车（如许可）。
1688 branding, orange accents, signage, corridors, details for graphics backgrounds. 品牌纹理、橙色元素、标识、走廊细节。
Crew setting up, Aria arriving, prompter tests, the interview corner being built. 花絮：搭建、Aria到达、提词器测试。

blocks.text: Shot list B · D2 morning plates · 第二天上午空镜

cells: Undisturbed entrance and building at good light; static wides; slow moves. No drone. 无人干扰的入口和楼体，静态全景、慢推拉；不用无人机。
Every 1688 mark on campus, clean, static and moving. 园区所有1688标识，干净、静态与运动镜头。
Office environment without people; desks, screens off or clean. 无人办公环境。
Anything on list A not captured on day one. 第一天遗漏的细节。
Static wide of the interview corner, empty, for graphics. 访谈角空镜，供后期图形使用。
Sound only: campus, lobby, office, goods-out. 环境声：园区、大堂、办公区、出货区。

blocks.text: Files, backup, checkout · 文件、备份、收工

items: Folder per block: D1_TESTIMONIAL, D1_QA, D1_WALK, D1_BROLL, D2_PLATES. Clip names carry the pack ID and take, for example D1_QA_B5_T2. 按环节建文件夹，文件名带本包编号与条次。
Dual backup at lunch and at checkout; card count; the log and the exceptions record handed to Steven the same day. 午休和收工各做一次双备份；日志与异常记录当天交给Steven。
4K, in-camera audio kept, separate audio tracks per speaker. Delivery on an encrypted drive plus cloud, as in the vendor plan. 4K、保留机内音轨、分轨音频；加密硬盘加云盘交付。
Release forms: Ary, Aria, and anyone in focus. 授权书：Ary、Aria及所有合焦人物。

blocks.text: Do not shoot · 不拍

items: Anything 1688 marks as sensitive. Personal data on any screen. Client or buyer names anywhere. Unreleased faces in close-up. Anything already in 1688's official footage pack. 1688标注的敏感区域；屏幕上的个人信息；任何客户名称；未授权人脸特写；1688官方素材包已有的内容。

sections.title: What we ask 1688 in writing
sections.lead: Four written lists, handed over through Aria before the day. The footage pack and the data sheet decide how much of the pack can be used; the permits and approvals decide what can be shot.

blocks.text: 1 · Official footage pack · 官方素材清单

items: Aerial and drone footage of the campus. 园区航拍。
Campus exteriors and interiors: showroom, sample selection centre, warehouse and logistics, events. 园区内外景：展厅、选品中心、仓储物流、活动。
Historical photographs, 1999 onwards: the early office, the early site. 历史照片：1999年起的早期办公室与网站。
Logo files and brand guidelines for co-branded use, including the on-screen credit. 品牌标识文件与使用规范，含联合署名。

Clean screen recordings of the app: image search, a listing with the factory signals, price tiers, a sample order, checkout with the cross-border payment option; 9:16 and 16:9. 应用界面干净录屏：以图搜货、含实力标识的商品页、阶梯价、样品单、含跨境支付选项的结账页；竖版与横版。
Any existing English-language brand or platform video. 现有英文品牌或平台视频。
A usage rights statement: channels, territories, duration. 使用授权说明：渠道、地区、期限。

blocks.text: 2 · Data and sign-off for the answer sheets · 答题卡需确认的数据

cells: The authoritative list of markets where a business can register and pay direct today. 可注册并直接付款的国家和地区名单。
The current registration and verification path for a business outside China, in three steps. 海外企业注册与认证的现行流程，三步。
Which orders accept foreign cards, and the limit. 外卡适用订单与限额。
When the platform releases payment to the supplier on a cross-border order. 跨境订单的放款节点。
Confirmation of the 0.2 per cent cross-border payment platform fee wording. 0.2%平台费用的表述确认。
Where the direct payment option appears and the exceptions. 直接支付选项的覆盖与例外。
Whether domestic shipping is included on most listings; whether to mention 1688's own cross-border logistics and where. 国内运费是否包含；是否提及自营跨境物流及市场。
Four beats each for Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand: what they buy, what is growing, one surprise, one piece of advice; Vietnam adds why it came first. 马来西亚、越南、泰国各四拍；越南加“为何先开”。
Three updates from the last twelve months for overseas buyers. 近一年三条面向海外买家的更新。
Two or three forward statements 1688 will say on camera and release; approval on wording. 两到三条可公开的规划表述，措辞需审批。
Which listing signals 1688 endorses as marks of a real factory. 1688认可的实力工厂识别信号。
The current annual active buyer number and whether an overseas number can be said. 年活跃买家数及是否可说海外数据。
The dispute route for cross-border orders and any policy change this year. 跨境订单纠纷流程及今年政策变化。

blocks.text: 3 · Permits and areas · 拍摄许可与区域

items: Two-day permit: 7 September full day, 8 September morning. 两天许可：7日全天，8日上午。
The list of shootable areas, and the sensitive lines: no-go areas, screens, names. 可拍区域清单及敏感线：禁拍区、屏幕、名称。
Whether the sample selection centre is on campus and open to the crew on the day. 选品中心是否在园区、当天能否进入。
A quiet room for the interview corner with controllable air conditioning and power, identifiable as 1688. 一间安静、可控空调、有电源、有1688辨识度的房间。
A 1688 contact on site for the day, and gear access: parking, loading, lifts. 当天现场对接人；设备通行：停车、装卸、电梯。

blocks.text: 4 · Approvals and releases · 审批与授权

items: Ary's appearance release and the location release, signed on the day. Ary出镜授权与场地授权，当天签署。
The brand approval process for the cuts: who reviews, and the turnaround. 成片审批流程：审核人与周期。
Approval of the on-screen credit wording in section 06. 第06节联合署名措辞的确认。
1688's own release plan: which channels, in which form. 1688自有渠道的发布计划与形式。

blocks.text: If 1688 can give one more hour in the seat on 7 September, the stretch takes in section 03 run. Ary's total on-camera time would then be about three and a half hours.

sections.title: Day-of checklist
sections.lead: What has to exist on the morning of 7 September, and who brings it.

rows.label: Paper
rows.value: Two printed sets of section 04 in large type for Ary, cut lines crossed out; Aria's host sheet; the crew sheet; release forms; this pack on every phone. Steven.

rows.label: Prompter
rows.value: Tablet with a teleprompter app, loaded with sections 02, 04 and 06, tested in the morning corner. Crew, text from Steven.

rows.label: Brackets
rows.value: Every bracket in section 04 either filled by 1688 or crossed out before lunch. Aria, from the section 09 data sheet.

rows.label: Wardrobe
rows.value: Aria in WorldFirst colours, plain, no fine patterns. Ary in plain business wear, no fine stripes, no logos other than 1688, a spare shirt for the heat. Aria confirms with Ary the day before.

rows.label: Props
rows.value: Ary's own phone with the 1688 app logged in; two or three sample products for leg two; a clean laptop or phone for the screen B-roll. If a WorldFirst account linked to 1688 can be ready for the checkout screen, Steven or Aria brings it.

rows.label: People
rows.value: Steven on site, off camera. Aria hosting. A 1688 contact on site. Sean and Alan's team as per the vendor plan.

rows.label: Backups
rows.value: Two cards per camera, dual record, power banks, water. Crew.

rows.label: Timing guards
rows.value: 14:00 testimonial start; 15:10 checkpoint; 16:30 Ary released regardless; 17:30 checkout done. Aria keeps the clock.

rows.label: After
rows.value: Shot log and exceptions record to Steven the same evening; footage handover per the crew sheet. Crew.
